name: skills-manager
description: Manage AI agent skills (SKILL.md), playbooks and value chains: list, toggle, categorise, install from GitHub/monorepo/ZIP/local/marketplace, update, freeze, scan, export, index; run and organise playbooks; map skills and playbooks to value chains. Port of the Obsidian Skills Manager plugin plus BOB playbooks.

skillsDir.title: Skills directory
skillsDir.description: Folder holding one sub-folder per skill, relative to the working directory or absolute

githubPat.title: GitHub PAT
githubPat.description: Personal access token for private repos and higher rate limits

autoUpdate.title: Check for updates on start
autoUpdate.description: Check unfrozen GitHub skills 60s after the session starts

generateSkillsIndex.title: Generate SKILLS.md
generateSkillsIndex.description: Write a skill index at the working directory root after every change

crossToolExportEnabled.title: Cross-tool export
crossToolExportEnabled.description: Export enabled skills to other AI tools after every change

playbookFolders.title: Playbook folders
playbookFolders.description: Comma-separated folders scanned for notes with type: playbook

valueChains.title: Value chains
valueChains.description: Comma-separated chain ids; empty uses the built-in 13 chains plus infrastructure
